summary: Eco Wave Power Global AB (publ) filed a prospectus supplement (424B5) for a registered direct offering of 400,000 ADSs (each representing 8 common shares) and warrants to purchase up to 300,000 ADSs at an exercise price of $12.00 per ADS. The combined purchase price per ADS and warrant is $10.00, a 10.9% premium to the $9.02 last sale price. Maxim Group LLC is the sole placement agent, receiving a 6.0% cash fee. The offering is a routine capital raise, not a special situation. Delivery is expected on or about June 26, 2026. This is an ordinary shelf takedown under Rule 424(b)(5); no special-situations category applies.
